summary: Republic Services filed an 8-K reporting a registered public offering of $700M 4.750% notes due 2031 and $500M 5.000% notes due 2036 via an underwriting agreement with BofA and Wells Fargo. The offering is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Proceeds are used for general corporate purposes; closing expected June 26, 2026. No unusual structural features, activist involvement, or corporate event trigger.
